label: LLM request (simple)
info:
Minimal example of the llm-request node.

1. Configure the LLM Plugin in the editor sidebar first (provider, model, API key if needed).
2. Set a model on the LLM node (or leave it and pass msg.model).
3. Click the inject button and watch the debug sidebar.

The node shows its progress as a status: blue while waiting (with elapsed seconds), green when done, red on error or timeout. The timeout defaults to 3600 seconds (1 hour) because local LLMs can be slow; lower it here or via msg.timeout if you prefer to fail fast.

name: Ask a question
payload: Summarize what MQTT is in two sentences.
